title_sq: Apartament 2+1 ne shitje tek Kopshti Zologjik ne Tirane
description_sq:
Kopshti Zologjik , ne fund te Rruges Eduard Mano, disponojme per shitje Apartament 2+1, me siperfaqe 100 m2, ne katin 1 banim te nje pallati te ri me ashensor. Apartamenti organizohet ne dhome ndenje se bashku me ambjentin e gatimi, korridori shperndares, 2 dhomat e gjumit, dhe tualet . Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Shitet si ne Foto.
Shitet : 155.000 Euro ( i padiskutueshem )
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at the Zoo in Tirana
description_en: Zoological Garden, at the end of Eduard Mano Street, we have for sale a 2+1 apartment, with an area of ​​100 m2, on the 1st floor of a new residential building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in a living room together with a kitchen area, distribution corridor, 2 bedrooms, and a bathroom. Has regular mortgage documentation. Sold as in the photo. For sale: 155,000 Euros (indisputable)
